notes: New: on-device purge of Secure Folder items from the notification log. Run it from JC Settings (Secure Folder section, main profile only) or POST /notifications/log/purge-sf. Tagged Secure Folder entries are removed by their profile tag; legacy untagged WhatsApp entries can be matched on-device by contact names you supply at purge time (never stored, never in the app). Reporting is counts only — tagged removed / legacy removed / remaining — no notification content is ever shown or sent anywhere.
